name: Octavia E. Butler Landing Site
description: Flat open terrain where Perseverance touched down on Mars. Primary mission staging zone.
science_purpose: Flat open terrain where Perseverance touched down on Mars. Primary mission staging zone.

name: Séítah Formation
description: Ancient layered olivine and pyroxene bedrock formed early in Martian history.

name: Three Forks
description: Key intersection at the delta front where ancient river tributaries met Jezero lake.

name: Cape Nukshak
description: Elevated delta outcrop providing panoramic exposure of ancient river delta sediments.
science_purpose: Elevated delta outcrop providing panoramic exposure of ancient river delta sediments.

name: Hogwallow Flats
description: Fine-grained sedimentary rocks with high potential for preserving ancient biosignatures.
